# netskope_network_profile (Data Source)

NetworkProfile DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_network_profile" "my_networkprofile" {
  id = "...my_id..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Network Profile UUID (assigned by API)

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Profile description (max 200 characters)
- `name` (String) Profile name (max 100 characters)
- `values` (List of String) List of IP addresses, CIDR blocks, or IP ranges (e.g. "192.168.0.1/24", "10.0.0.1-10.0.0.254")
